entities.name: Joaquín María de Ferrer y Cafranga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joaquín María de Ferrer y Cafranga was a Spanish politician and military who served as Prime Minister of Spain in 1841, and held other important offices such as Minister of State, Mayor of Madrid and President of the Senate. He also served as Deputy Prime Minister between 1840 and 1841. He also served as a Deputy for Guipúzcoa from 1822 to 1837.
